messages:
Rory Li: Starting Comet LoRA merge for customer 'Orbit' — noticed consistent comma dropout in amounts on their invoice prompts, pushing quick-eval summary.
Asha Mehta: paste quick-eval please.
Rory Li: ```
quickpack: 250 Orbit invoice prompts
model: base-comet + LoRA (orbit-adapter-v1)
quant sim: fp16 -> int8/4 (sim)
metrics (baseline -> merged):
- exact_match (amount slot): 0.880 -> 0.812 (-6.8%)
- f1 (date): 0.91 -> 0.90 (-1.1%)
- token_ll_mean: -1.95 -> -2.23
- p99 latency (sim): 145ms -> 125ms
notes: formatting drift: "USD 2,450" -> "USD 2450"; also occasional trailing ".00" dropped.
```
Priyanka Rao: ugh. Did you run with tokenizer preservation or numeric whitelist? which quant tool?
Rory Li: ran the internal quant-sim quick path. command:
```
python infra/quant/simulate.py --model base-comet --lora artifacts/orbit_lora_v1.pt --bits 4 --token-preserve \",\".\" --warm-cache 50
```
Asha Mehta: small ask: can we test three blend alphas (0.4/0.6/0.8) and int8 sim as well? Also add a strict-format few-shot prompt with examples to the pack.
Rory Li: yes — scheduling 3 x 250 runs. will also add a slot-extract harness for amounts, invoice_id, due_date (500 targeted prompts).
DevOpsBot: Canary policy note: routing pin available.
LMSRE: Quick smoke finished  regressions flagged for amount exact_match; creating ticket infra/triage#1849.
eval-bot: Autogenerated summary: amount-slot exact_match dropped 6.8% -> flagged. Results stored: s3://redwood-evals/orbit/comet-lora/pack-1766688888/results.json
Priyanka Rao: mitigation ideas: 1) reduce merge alpha; 2) apply regex-based normalizer on model output to re-insert commas before downstream processing; 3) try constrained decoding (allow digits, comma, period) for amount tokens; 4) canary route to 'comet-stable' variant.
Asha Mehta: I can prototype the regex normalizer quickly — will try both reformat-to-locale and fallback to numeric parse.
Rory Li: plan: run blends alpha=0.4/0.6/0.8 (int8+int4 sims), enable KV warmstart, and include few-shot system message: 'Return amounts with thousands separator for en_US locale.' If alpha=0.6 still bad, enable postproc normalizer and pin routing to comet-stable for a 48h canary.
Priyanka Rao: I'll put a temp feature-flag to route Orbit traffic to comet-stable while we validate.
Asha Mehta: Prototype normalizer: `re.sub(r"([0-9])(\d{3})(?!\d)", r"\1,\2", s)` — will run on eval outputs and report corrected exact_match.
Rory Li: Update (later): alpha=0.6 + int8 sim brought amount exact_match delta to -1.7% and reformat normalizer recovers ~90% of comma cases. Full regressions running now.
Rory Li: Final decision: merge with alpha=0.6, enable output normalizer in pre-ingest pipeline for Orbit, and set a 48h canary routing to comet-stable. Scheduling full eval report and customer sync. :white_check_mark:
